_readme: Template only. Copy to paths.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: the folders that several configs point at, set once. A config that has this file in its "_include" can write "${name}" anywhere in a setting, e.g. "data_yaml": "${pruned_dataset}/data.yaml". The names are yours to choose: add, rename or remove entries freely. An entry may use another one ("${datasets_root}/my_dataset"), and a relative path is resolved against the folder this file is in.
